items.heading: Ful Medames Sudani
details: Key ingredients: fava beans, garlic, oil, lemon
Simmer fava beans until very soft.
Mash lightly and season with garlic, lemon and oil.
Warm through gently.
Serve with bread for scooping, often topped with tomato and onion.

items.heading: Kisra
details: Key ingredients: sorghum flour, water
Ferment a thin sorghum flour batter overnight.
Pour a thin layer onto a very hot flat griddle.
Cook briefly until set into a large, thin, slightly sour flatbread.
Serve alongside stews and sauces.
